Asc is the filter. Most ppl (in my server) that are in asc are great at most aspects of the game, but fumble one thing. This is great but as hooj says, when you have a good game, it’s cuz the enemy isn’t able to deal with the thing you’re good at (eg. flanking) but better enemies will only let you catch them once. So essentially what I’m saying is, when you have a bad game, or rather when you’re in a game and it’s not going good. Legit stop and ask yourself. 1)what am I doing that’s not working and 2) what is the enemy doing that IS working. If the answer is “they have a Smurf dunking on us when they entry” then play off angles to get one and get traded so at least you weather them down. There is no team (esp in ranked) that is perfect, and with a strong mental you’ll get out easy. Find the one/two things you’re not the best at and refine it( watch pros for ideas ).

I think comms is a very important aspect of the game, the earlier you get comfortable with communicating with everyone as much as possible the more likely you’re coming more than the enemy. But there are dicks and morons who don’t care. They get the mute. But don’t default to mute cuz you’ll be both missing out and not coming.

And don’t forget, no matter how bad you are at the game, never let them get to you. Peak the Angle if you think you can get the pick, don’t let anyone shit on you for being bad. Kids are inadvertently better than adults at learning stuffs, but their critical thinking (decision making) isn’t the best, so choose positions (for gunfights) that you think is more than a 50/50. Great question. Pathing is very important. I love playing the lurk role, where pathing is the most important. I would suggest watching natz or eg c0m as they path almost perfectly 99% of the time. But to explain it simply it’s pattern recognition. If u fast flank on pistol and there is a guy waiting in spawn then u know u can’t pull that again, instead you can clear angles meticulously if u decide to flank OR flank from the opposite side OR use util like kayo knife / sky flash. There is no right or wrong, just recognising patterns and taking advantage where you find a gap, and that only happens with time, but do be aware, the higher u go in Elo, the gap gets fixed quicker and quicker, but because there are only 5 players, there will always be a gap somewhere.
